import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import random
import statistics
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--rounds', type=int, default=80)
parser.add_argument('--output', required=True)
parser.add_argument('binaries', nargs='+')
args = parser.parse_args()
binaries = dict(item.split('=', 1) for item in args.binaries)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='xff-timezone-') as temporary:
    root = Path(temporary)
    for count in [0, 10, 100, 1000]:
        directory = root / str(count)
        directory.mkdir()
        for number in range(count):
            (directory / f'file{number}.txt').write_text('matched content\n')
    cases = {
        'version': ['--version'],
        'empty': [str(root / '0'), '-type', 'f'],
        'empty-utc': ['--timezone=UTC', str(root / '0'), '-type', 'f'],
        'files-10': [str(root / '10'), '-type', 'f'],
        'files-100': [str(root / '100'), '-type', 'f'],
        'files-1000': [str(root / '1000'), '-type', 'f'],
        'content-1000': [str(root / '1000'), '-rxc', 'matched'],
        'local-time-field': [str(root / '10'), '--template={mtime:%Y-%m-%d %z}'],
        'explicit-utc-field': [str(root / '10'), '--timezone=UTC', '--template={mtime:%Y-%m-%d %z}'],
    }
    pairs = [(variant, case) for variant in binaries for case in cases]
    samples = {variant: {case: [] for case in cases} for variant in binaries}
    rng = random.Random(20261002)
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env.pop('DYLD_PRINT_INITIALIZERS', None)
    env.pop('DYLD_PRINT_LIBRARIES', None)
    with open(os.devnull, 'wb') as sink:
        for round_index in range(args.rounds + 4):
            rng.shuffle(pairs)
            for variant, case in pairs:
                start = time.perf_counter_ns()
                subprocess.run([binaries[variant], *cases[case]], stdout=sink, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env, check=True)
                elapsed = (time.perf_counter_ns() - start) / 1e6
                if round_index >= 4:
                    samples[variant][case].append(elapsed)
            if round_index % 20 == 0:
                print(f'Round {round_index}/{args.rounds + 4}', flush=True)
    report = {
        'host': platform.platform(),
        'cpu': subprocess.run(['sysctl', '-n', 'machdep.cpu.brand_string'], text=True, capture_output=True).stdout.strip() or 'unavailable',
        'rounds': args.rounds,
        'warmups_discarded': 4,
        'order': 'deterministically shuffled interleaved variants and cases per round',
        'timing': 'whole subprocess wall time, warm APFS, stdout discarded; includes parent launch and wait',
        'environment_TZ': env.get('TZ'),
        'binaries': {name: {'path': path, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'bytes': Path(path).stat().st_size} for name, path in binaries.items()},
        'cases': {name: [arg.replace(str(root), '$FIXTURE') for arg in argv] for name, argv in cases.items()},
        'samples_ms': samples,
        'medians_ms': {variant: {case: statistics.median(values) for case, values in groups.items()} for variant, groups in samples.items()},
    }
    Path(args.output).write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(report['medians_ms'], indent=2))
